messages:
Rae: dropping the weekly Nimbus health note here. Quick bullets: WoW token delta +17%, QoQ +39%. Billing up ~10% WoW. p95 latency bumped ~32ms. Error rate ~4.6% (primarily 429 throttles).
Hiro: thanks. Any concentrated hotspots by route/key?
Rae: looks focused on /v1/generate (~63% of token volume) and /v1/summary (~14%). Top API keys: ak-nimbus-main, ak-nimbus-batcher (combined ~80%). Spike window was 07:40-08:10 UTC yesterday.
alerts-bot: [ALERT] acct_nimbus - 5m 429s = 4.9% (threshold 3.5%). Trace: https://dd.example.com/d/nimbus/alerts
Leila: I pulled traces  we see KV-cache hit-rate drop during bursts and many parallel short-lived streams (clients opening multiple streams).
Tom: did they flip model defaults or ship a new feature? QoQ growth suggests product change rather than organic growth.
Rae: they launched a "daily-brief" capability in the last 6 weeks and switched non-critical traffic to rdx-3-small about 2 weeks ago.
Avery: rdx-3-small will increase per-token work. Short-term mitigations: 1) recommend client concurrency ceiling (3), 2) enable prefix caching on long prompt routes, 3) advise routing low-priority rerank/summary traffic to rdx-2-medium.
Hiro: I'll prepare a per-route token/time slice. Query I ran (slightly different):
```sql
SELECT route, api_key, SUM(tokens) tokens, COUNT(*) calls, APPROX_QUANTILES(latency_ms, 100)[OFFSET(95)] p95_ms
FROM `redwood.telemetry.events`
WHERE account_id = 'acct_nimbus' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY route, api_key
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 15;
```
Hiro: top rows show /v1/generate + ak-nimbus-main = 61% tokens, /v1/summary + ak-nimbus-batcher = 13%.
Leila: nice. For customer-facing guidance I'll draft SDK examples in Go to vary from previous notes. Sample Go snippet: 
```go
// Go SDK: reduce concurrency + enable batching
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{Concurrency:3, BatchWindowMs:30})
client.EnablePrefixCache("/v1/generate")
```
Tom: useful. Also propose a soft rate-limit on ak-nimbus-batcher for the next 48 hours while we run the enablement. Helps reduce 429s quickly.
Rae: good. Action items: Hiro -> attach per-route telemetry + heatmap; Leila -> prepare Go + JS SDK snippets and short playbook; Tom -> draft cost delta for two options (A: move rerank/summary to rdx-2-medium, B: keep rdx-3-small but enforce batching/caching). I'll coordinate scheduling.
Avery: availability for a 30m enablement session: Mon 13:00 UTC or Tue 09:00 UTC. Which works for Nimbus devs?
Rae: I'll propose Mon 13:00 UTC. If they accept, agenda: 10min telemetry recap, 10min demo (batching + prefix cache), 10min Q&A + next steps.
Hiro: I'll attach the query results and a small chart showing tokens by hour to ticket RED-4321.
Leila: I'll include short troubleshooting checklist for increased concurrency and a fallback plan for the AE (cost vs latency).
Tom: once we have estimates I'll coordinate with AE for renewal prep. Flagging moderate renewal risk if spend trend continues.
Rae: thanks team. I'll update the ticket and close this thread for now. Reopen if error rate exceeds 6% before the session. :thumbsup:
